julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-eva.description: Test harness for the Signal Prospecting Kit v4.1. Runs deterministic checks and rubric-based grading against all 6 skills including tool connections, multi-batch flow, LinkedIn outreach, channel selection, self-improvement loop, enrichment tiers, bridge/CTA variation, variation planning, and fallback tool detection. Triggers: /eval, /eval all, /eval {skill-name}, /eval simulate. Does NOT require WebSearch — validates structure, rules, and simulated output.
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-eva.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash, Agent

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-out.description: Takes the prospect list and writes personalized cold emails and/or LinkedIn connection requests. Signal-driven, product-specific, in the user's voice. Asks channel preference (email, LinkedIn, or both) before drafting. Batch mode for multiple prospects, single mode for one. Triggers: /outreach, "write emails", "draft outreach", "write linkedin", "draft linkedin", "outreach email", "outreach linkedin", "outreach both". Reads: ./gtm/icp.md, ./gtm/voice.md, ./gtm/company.md, ./gtm/signals.md, ./gtm/prospects.md, ./gtm/learnings.md. Writes: updates prospects.md status, appends to learnings.md.…
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-out.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pro.description: Researches the user's market, competitors, and competitive positioning to build a complete ICP profile. Shows findings for user approval before proceeding. Triggers: /profile, "research my market", "who are my competitors". Reads: ./gtm/company.md, ./gtm/icp.md. Writes: updates ./gtm/icp.md with competitive positioning. Standalone: yes (asks for domain if company.md missing).
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pro.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pro.description: Finds companies matching the ICP that are showing buying signals right now, then finds contacts at the best ones. Builds a scored prospect list for outreach. Triggers: /prospect, "find companies", "build a list", "find prospects". Reads: ./gtm/icp.md, ./gtm/signals.md, ./gtm/company.md. Writes: ./gtm/prospects.md. Standalone: yes.
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pro.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pus.description: Exports approved outreach emails into the user's preferred format: sequencer CSV, plain text, or formatted for specific tools. Triggers: /push, "export emails", "push to instantly", "push to outreach". Reads: ./gtm/prospects.md, ./gtm/icp.md (for stack info). Writes: output files in ./gtm/export/. Standalone: yes.
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-pus.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-sig.description: Identifies the buying signal TYPES that matter for the user's market, then uses them to find companies showing those signals right now. Triggers: /signal-scout, "find signals", "what signals matter". Reads: ./gtm/icp.md, ./gtm/company.md. Writes: ./gtm/signals.md. Standalone: yes — asks what they sell if no context exists.
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-sig.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Glob, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch

julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-sta.description: Entry point for the Signal Prospecting Kit. Deep onboarding: researches the user's company from their domain, captures ICP, stack, and voice. Routes to /profile for market research. Triggers: /start, first run, "help me set up". Reads: ./gtm/ (all files). Writes: ./gtm/company.md, ./gtm/icp.md, ./gtm/voice.md. Standalone: yes.
julienamorgan-signal-prospecting-kit-sta.tools: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob, Bash, Agent, WebSearch, WebFetch
